name: Icon
summary: An SVG icon from the Vectra sprite, drawn with <use>, that takes the text colour and scales with the font size.
description: About 150 icons ship in dist/icons/sprite.svg, drawn from Lucide (ISC). Reference one by name; to ship only the ones a site uses, run npx vectra-icons "pages/**/*.html" --out icons.subset.svg. There is no icon font and no CDN.

classes.name: v-icon
classes.description: Sizes the svg to 1.15em, strokes it in currentcolor and stops it shrinking in flex rows. Components such as buttons and badges resize it to fit.

a11y: Mark an icon next to text aria-hidden="true", so it is not read.
An icon that is the only content of a button needs an aria-label on the button.
A standalone icon that carries meaning needs role="img" and an aria-label on the svg.
Icons use currentcolor, so they follow the text colour and switch with forced colours mode.

examples.title: Usage
examples.html:
<svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#search"/></svg>
<svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#settings"/></svg>
<svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#download"/></svg>
<svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#heart"/></svg>
<svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#warning"/></svg>
<svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#check"/></svg>

examples.title: In buttons
examples.html:
<button class="v-btn v-btn-primary" type="button"><svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#search"/></svg>Search</button>
<button class="v-btn v-btn-secondary" type="button"><svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#download"/></svg>Download</button>
<button class="v-btn v-btn-ghost v-btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Settings"><svg class="v-icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="/icons/sprite.svg#settings"/></svg></button>

examples.title: Size and colour
examples.description: An icon is 1.15em, so set font-size to resize it and color to recolour it.
